infographic.title: Four Common Level Switch Types
infographic.alt: Infographic showing four common level switch types: float, vibrating fork, conductive and capacitive
steps: A float rides on the liquid and moves a magnet that operates a reed switch.
A fork vibrates at resonance; product contact changes the vibration.
Conductive liquid bridges two electrodes and current flows.
Product changes the capacitance between the probe and the tank wall.
